prompt: Static camera. Immediately the masked auctioneer slowly raises his gloved left hand a little higher and holds it steady, palm out, unhurried, like a policeman halting traffic. The audience heads in the foreground shift slightly. After a pause he lifts the gavel and strikes the lectern once, firmly, then rests both hands. His head barely moves; the navy balaclava with its white ring and red triangle over his left eye keeps its exact shape and covers him completely, gloves on both hands. The "£50" on the blackboard stays clear and unchanged. Greenery overhead sways faintly; rain streaks the tent window. Sound: the crowd murmur falling quiet, a single crisp gavel knock, gentle rain. Natural overcast light.
